draft.title: Discussion skills
card: Listening
pay attention to the speaker and wait until they finish. You cannot respond well to an idea you did not hear.
Building on ideas
add to what someone has said, for example by giving another example or a reason. This moves the discussion forward.
Asking questions
ask others to explain or give more detail, such as "What made you think that?" This helps everyone understand.
Disagreeing politely
say you see it differently and give a reason. Focus on the idea, not on the person who said it.
draft.remember: A good discussion listens, adds, asks and disagrees with reasons.

a.q: In a group talk about canteen food, Tom says fresh fruit is a good choice. Priya replies that she agrees and adds that fruit costs less in bulk. Which skill is Priya using?
opts: Building on another person's idea
Disagreeing politely with a reason
Asking a question to get more detail
Listening without saying anything
a.why: Priya links her point to Tom's and adds a new reason. She does not disagree or ask a question, so building on ideas fits best.
a.clue: Notice that Priya adds to Tom's point.

b.q: Leo thinks the class excursion should be to the museum. Mia wants the zoo. Which reply from Leo shows good discussion skills?
opts: I see it differently, because the museum fits our topic
That is a silly idea, so we should not discuss it
I will talk louder until everyone agrees with me
I have nothing to add, so I will say nothing
b.why: Leo says he disagrees and gives a reason, and he does not criticise Mia. Calling her idea silly attacks the person, not the idea.
b.clue: A polite disagreement includes a reason.

b.best: I see it differently, because the museum fits our topic

problems.detail: The why says calling Mia's idea silly 'attacks the person, not the idea'. The reply 'That is a silly idea' dismisses the idea rather than attacking Mia, so this blurs the card's distinction between focusing on the idea and the person. It would be better to say it dismisses the idea rudely without giving a reason.
The clue 'Notice that Priya adds to Tom's point' repeats the card's definition of building on ideas ('add to what someone has said'), so it gives the answer away rather than hinting.
